slides.title: 3 iPhone settings that actually stop 1am scrolling
slides.aside: (and the one everyone turns on that doesn't. save this for tonight)

slides.heading: Sleep Focus _doesn't lock anything_
slides.text:
it only picks which apps can _send notifications_

instagram still opens. it just stops buzzing
slides.bottom: keep it for the noise, not the scrolling

slides.heading: Downtime has a _hidden switch_
slides.text:
on its own, Downtime is a reminder you can _tap straight past_

set a Screen Time passcode (next slide) and you can turn on _Block at Downtime_. then the apps actually grey out

slides.heading: let _someone else_ set the passcode
slides.top: *Settings → Screen Time → Lock Screen Time Settings*
slides.text:
a code you know is a code you'll type at 1am

hand your phone to a roommate or partner and let them pick 4 digits _you don't see_. skip passcode recovery

slides.heading: grayscale on a _triple-click_
slides.top: *Settings → Accessibility → Display & Text Size → Color Filters → Grayscale*
slides.text:
add Color Filters to the _Accessibility Shortcut_ and the side button flips it

grey tiktok is _boring tiktok_. small studies saw people use their phones a bit less, but it wears off

slides.heading: the part settings _can't do_
slides.top: downtime ends at 7. the scroll starts at 7:01
slides.text:
so i use _locturne_. my apps stay asleep in the morning until i've _walked 200 steps_

screen time can't make you get up. this can

slides.question: which one are you setting up tonight? 👇
lines: start with the passcode one. it takes 2 minutes
locturne is on the App Store
